gap: The isolated-triple versus same-passage-context supervision contrast has only been evaluated on two synthetic biomedical disease KGs with multiple-choice answers; there is no evidence on open-answer, general-domain multi-hop benchmarks with gold evidence paths.

evidence.quote: Third, although we evaluate the framework on two disease settings, Gastroparesis and Diabetes, broader validation is still needed.
First, the QA datasets used for SFT, repair, RL, and evaluation are synthetically generated.
In our dataset, we introduce the evidence information containing a reasoning path for multi-hop questions.

why_unaddressed: The validating study is deliberately domain-specific: disease KGs extracted with GraphMERT, synthetic multiple-choice QA spanning 1-5 hops, and its authors state that broader validation is still needed. General-domain benchmarks with gold evidence paths exist (2WikiMultiHopQA, MoreHopQA), and hop-stratified KBQA splits exist (MetaQA-1/2/3-hop), but the standard KBQA pipelines run on Freebase entity/relation neighbourhoods with no per-triple passage provenance, so the 'same source passage' context construction has never been instantiated there.
research_question: Does context-augmented supervision improve multi-hop accuracy on open-answer, general-domain benchmarks when context triples are drawn from the same source passage, and does the effect persist at 3+ hops?
potential_experiment: Build same-passage triple provenance for a passage- or Wikidata-linked benchmark such as 2WikiMultiHopQA and for the MetaQA hop splits, replicate the KG-grounded versus CG-grounded SFT contrast with a token-matched control arm, and evaluate EM/F1 and evidence-path faithfulness by hop depth against the subgraph-reasoner and teacher-student baselines. Report whether the effect size survives the change of domain, answer format and model.
verification_required: Confirm whether any existing passage-aligned KGQA resource or Wikidata-Wikipedia provenance mapping already exists that would make this inexpensive to construct; the search budget was reached before this could be checked. Also re-check whether arxiv:2609.12230 has a released artefact that can be re-pointed at another KG.
